theoretical_input.fixed_case: D_eff = D when no downstream compensation is available
theoretical_input.hidden_state_adaptive: E[D_eff(H)|I] when compensation may adapt after H is learned
theoretical_input.hidden_state_precommitted: min_c E[K(c,H)+M(delta-c,H)|I] when compensation must be chosen before H

direct_empirical_requirements: independently estimated effective waiting cost D_eff for each actor, either directly in fitness units or through a preregistered decomposition into raw delay delta, compensatory capacity C, compensation cost K, and residual timing-loss function M
state-mismatch losses C_F and C_M plus prior pi on the same utility scale
observed cue-use decision distinguishing commit-now from wait/use-cue
repeated q support crossing the predicted threshold or pairwise asynchronous window

if compensation occurs in multiple stages, a preregistered causal model must map each stage's recoverable delay and cost into the common D_eff utility scale rather than multiplying observed timing correlations
primary_predictions: D_eff_1 < D_eff_2 implies q_1 < q_2 under shared state-loss structure
Delta q = |D_eff_2-D_eff_1|/(A+L) when both thresholds are finite
actors with equal raw delay can have unequal q thresholds if compensatory capacity or compensation cost differs
exactly one actor uses the shared cue for min(q_1,q_2) < q <= max(q_1,q_2)

inverse_validation.role: infer the effective fitness cost implied by an independently observed behavioral threshold
inverse_validation.strongest_test: compare D_eff_revealed with an independently estimated D_eff from delay, compensation and residual fitness data
inverse_validation.circularity_guard: cue-use observations used to estimate q_wait may not also define the independent D_eff comparator
inverse_validation.raw_delay_guard: D_eff_revealed must not be compared directly with days delayed unless the fitness mapping and downstream compensation model are independently specified

greater_snow_goose_status.perturbation_cost: captivity-duration manipulation provides D-like perturbation but mixes delay with handling/confinement stress
greater_snow_goose_status.timing_loss: Bylot long-term reproductive-success surface provides two-sided C_F-like/C_M-like anchors
greater_snow_goose_status.compensation: 1997-1999 tracking shows later departure associated with shorter migration duration and weak departure-arrival coupling
greater_snow_goose_status.behavioral_uptake: prospective 2019-2023 GPS lane registered but event access requires authenticated Movebank session and exact route geometry
greater_snow_goose_status.post_arrival_buffering: Bety et al. 2003: lay-date coefficient on relative arrival date 0.45 +/- 0.09 after premigration body-condition control; prelaying duration slope versus arrival -0.53 (R2=0.55); retained as phenomenological buffering only because sequential-timing inference has a published critique

promotion_rule: No direct natural D_eff-to-threshold claim until q, D_eff, the common loss scale, and cue-use switching are independently identified in one qualifying system under a pre-outcome contract.
